formulations.Transference notes: Read from Figure 1 and Figure 2; values vary with concentration (5-80 mol%).
formulations.Notes: Salt concentrations reported as mol% relative to EC monomer units. Li:monomer ratio ranges from 1/20 to 1/1.25 (5-80 mol%). PEC Mn = 37,000 g/mol. formulations.Reference: Journal of The Electrochemical Society, 162 (2) A3133-A3136 (2015)
